Step into a Hawaiian storybook at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, located in Ko Olina on the island of O‘ahu, just a short drive from Waikiki. Set along a stunning lagoon with a white-sand beach, the resort offers a range of rooms and spacious villas accommodating up to 12 guests — perfect for a multi-generational family chapter.

During your stay, you can enjoy immersive activities and entertainment inspired by Disney storytelling, meet your favourite characters (including Stitch!), take part in fun recreational programs, and unwind by themed pools and the lazy river. Kids will love the waterslides and splash zones, while the whole family can explore a variety of dining options and experience Aulani’s very own Luau.

The Islands of Hawaii

Hawaii is made up of multiple islands, each with its own unique charm — just like the chapters in your story. The main islands explored by visitors are Oahu, Kauai, Maui, and The Big Island. The original Lilo & Stitch film (2002) was set in Kauai, while the new live-action movie was filmed at various locations on Oahu.

  • Kauai: Lush green paradise with gorgeous beaches and mountain landscapes.
  • Oahu: Home to Aulani and iconic Waikiki Beach.
  • Maui: Diverse scenery from volcanic landscapes to golden beaches.
  • The Big Island: Features the dramatic Volcano National Park.

Hawaii’s stunning landscapes have been the backdrop for countless films and TV shows, including Lilo & Stitch, Soul Surfer, The Hunger Games: Catching Fire, and Jumanji. Each island is a chapter waiting to be explored — ready for you to step into your own storybook adventure.
